user.title: Connect to EMS
user.description: In EMS, open your station → Home Assistant and generate a pairing code. Enter your EMS HTTPS URL and the one-time code. No Home Assistant access token is required.

confirm.title: Confirm your connection
confirm.description: Connect **{instance}** to **{station}** ({station_id}). Continue only if this is your intended station.

entity.title: Select energy context
entity.description: Only selected entities are shared. The list shows entity/domain, unit, integration source and last update. Do not select individual presence, security, cameras, locks, alarms or location sensors. Occupancy must be a single household aggregate. Renamed or replaced entities require remapping.

data.source_validated: I verified the power/energy source and its units

review.title: Review data sharing
review.description:
{mappings}

EMS stores only the latest value, removes values after 24 hours and keeps timestamps for replay protection. Context never replaces the inverter meter or authorizes device control.

data.consent: Share only these selected entities with EMS
data.occupancy_consent: Allow this aggregate home/away sensor (no individual presence)
data.insights_consent: Allow future read-only insights and notifications based on this context

test.title: Test synchronization
test.description: Submit to send the reviewed mapping and one sample per selected entity. Unknown or unavailable values remain null. Success confirms EMS accepted this bridge; it does not certify the sensors.

error.cannot_connect: EMS is unreachable, disabled or rate limited. Check the HTTPS URL and retry.
error.invalid_auth: The code or credential is expired, already used or revoked. Generate a new code in EMS.
error.invalid_response: EMS rejected the request. Check backend compatibility and reconnect if mappings changed.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTPS origin with no path, credentials, query or fragment.
error.invalid_mapping: Check entity domain, unit, device class, state class, freshness and source validation.
error.aggregate_only: Only one household occupancy sensor is allowed.

abort.already_configured: This EMS station is already configured. Use its reauthentication flow to pair again.
abort.wrong_station: The code belongs to another station. Generate a code for the original station.
abort.no_entities: No eligible sensor entities are available.

disconnect.title: Disconnect and erase shared context
disconnect.description: Submit to stop this bridge, revoke its EMS credential and delete its shared context. If EMS is unreachable, publishing stops locally; retry here or disconnect from EMS to confirm remote deletion.
